method: Five GroupKFold splits by SOUID, covering every retained row out of fold. Raw ERA5, training-mean offset, additive spline ridge, histogram gradient boosting, and boosting plus neighbour-source relative elevation. Learned models share up to 800,000 sampled training rows per fold, seed 1337+fold. Imputation and spline transforms fit training rows only. No station temperature, midpoint or residual-derived feature enters predictors. Missing covariates remain missing for imputation/native tree handling; negative rain totals become missing log precipitation. These are source holdouts over mixed dates, not independent spatial or future-year validation. MAE-improvement intervals use paired SOUID bootstrap draws.
